redaction: Redacted copy: a user folder, name or email is replaced by <user>, <name> or <email> in text, or covered by a box in a picture; nothing else changed.
scope: Full current root including native custody, existing media owner/visual freshness and concept/handoff gates. No app/source-server/runtime/installer changes or stage acceptance.
preflight: Staged failed TAP log whitespace retained losslessly with verified base64/raw companion before root run; no check/configuration changed.

rawLog.normalization: LF and trailing horizontal whitespace in readable companion only; exact original process bytes retained.
